parsed.reasoning_brief: Signal shows PSP Acme PIX (Brazil) dropped from 94% to 25% success rate in 15min window (1200 attempts, 300 successes). This is a hard breach affecting 900 failed transactions. Without evidence—no provider status reports, internal tickets, or merchant reports—root cause is unclear. Could be provider outage, internal routing error, or credential/config issue. Escalation to human review required.
